verdict.rationale: Lago documents a dedicated MCP server giving AI assistants direct access to billing data, plus an Agent SDK and Dunning Agent that read invoices, payment history, and account status, alongside a full OpenAPI schema explicitly positioned for exposing billing actions to agents. This directly supports agent-driven queries about MRR-like state, delinquent accounts, and invoices, though there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server actually answering such queries in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of the MCP server's real-world query capabilities and explicit confirmation of MRR/renewal-specific queries beyond invoices/dunning.
